Sandbox_SlingRequired_MaterialsHeader_to: Choose which materials can be used to craft a Makeshift Sling. Enable the individual material options below to allow their crafting recipes. This heading checkbox has no effect.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Belts_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from belts.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_DenimStrips_toolti: Allow crafting makeshift slings from denim strips.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_LeatherStrips_tool: Allow crafting makeshift slings from leather strips.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Neckties_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from neckties.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Ropes_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from ropes.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Scarves_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from scarves.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Sheets_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from sheets (including sheet rope).
Sandbox_SlingRequired_Twine_tooltip: Allow crafting makeshift slings from twine.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_BackwearHeader_too: Choose which types of back-worn gear count as having a built-in sling when worn, even if they do not explicitly provide a Back attachment. Items that explicitly provide a Back attachment always qualify. This heading checkbox has no effect.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_HikingBackpacks_to: Allow worn hiking backpacks without a Back weapon attachment to unlock the Back hotbar slot. Explicit Back attachments always qualify.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_LargeFramepacks_to: Allow worn large framepacks without a Back weapon attachment to unlock the Back hotbar slot. Explicit Back attachments always qualify.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_MilitaryBackpacks_: Allow worn military backpacks / alice packs without a Back weapon attachment to unlock the Back hotbar slot. Explicit Back attachments always qualify.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_SchoolBackpacks_to: Allow worn school backpacks without a Back weapon attachment to unlock the Back hotbar slot. Explicit Back attachments always qualify.
Sandbox_SlingRequired_SlingBags_tooltip: Allow worn sling bags without a Back weapon attachment to unlock the Back hotbar slot. Explicit Back attachments always qualify.
